relevance_note: Two Tangier disease patients with ABCA1 variants are described individually, e.g. "Whole-exon analysis revealed compound heterozygosity of R579^* and R1572^* nonsense mutations in ABCA1".
method_note: Read in full and built by hand-written Python (no automatic table transcription); Table 1 has patients as columns (column headers 'Case 1', 'Case 2'). Labels: the text uses 'case 1' (12x) more than 'Case 1' (5x); 'case 2'/'Case 2' tie (4x each), so lower case was used for both for consistency. Parents of both cases are included as relatives described in relation to the probands (Fig. 2 legend and Discussion); case 2's parents are not stated to have been tested (pedigree legend lists 'N.D., not done' without saying for whom), so they have no variant rows. Variant nucleotide changes are printed as legacy 'G1452A'-style strings without a 'c.' prefix and without a transcript; recorded as printed in cdna_hgvs_as_stated. Table 1 prints the second case-1 variant as 'S13431', while the text everywhere prints 'S1343I'; variant_original_string keeps the table string, protein field uses the text string. Contradiction/tension for case 1: Table 1 gives 'Atherosclerosis' '-' and 'Plaque Score' 0, but the text reports 'a mild plaque at the beginning of the right subclavian artery (max IMT 1.8 mm)' while the table gives max IMT 'Rt. 0.5 / Lt. 0.5'; '-' and '＋' are not defined in the legend, so no excluded row was made from '-', the plaque is recorded as observed, and the non-coronary atherosclerosis checklist item is left 'not reported' for case 1. '＋' cells ('Typical TD phenotype', case 2 'Atherosclerosis') were read as present though the legend does not define the symbol. Table cells 'Rt. x / Lt. y' (ABI, PWV, max IMT) are right/left labelled values, not stacked per-patient values. Not marked from lab values alone: ApoA1 (17 and 2 mg/dL), LDL-C and triglycerides are not described as low/high by the authors, so those checklist items are 'not reported'; case 1's 'decreased nerve conduction velocity' was not mapped to the 'peripheral neuropathy' checklist item. Case 2's father (HDL approximately 30 mg/dL) is not described as low, so no low-HDL row. 'No family history of coronary artery disease' was not used to exclude CAD in the parents. 'No cardiovascular complications' (both parents of case 2) was used to exclude coronary artery disease (broader absence excludes narrower). Case 1 also has Krabbe disease; her GALC variants '12del3ins' and 'L380F' are given rows as printed (no zygosity, nt change or transcript stated; '12del3ins' left without a variant type and protein field because its notation level is unclear). Ages '20-year-old' and '51-year-old' are ages at presentation/admission (Table 1 'on admission'), recorded as age at last evaluation.
